unknowns-resolved.reason: ⚠️ SATISFIED UNDER THIS PROJECT'S DEFERRED-VALIDATION RULE, not by every unknown being closed, and the distinction is load-bearing: stage 3 asks whether the unknowns are RESOLVED OR DISPOSED OF, and stage 4 asks whether the gaps are DECIDED. QST-0033 is measured as far as it can be and is disposed of here with a task and a reopening condition; it remains an undecided gap at stage 4 and a critical question at stage 9, both of which are correctly not-satisfied. CLOSED BY MEASUREMENT, each with a control, on Windows and Linux against the pinned runtime: QST-0026 the public trust API; QST-0027 session relocation by three routes; QST-0028 the package entry with its canonical-equivalence proof; QST-0029 the child environment, from a dedicated exact-environment cell recorded from the EFFECTIVE environment rather than the caller's intent; QST-0030 task binding with closed stdin; QST-0031 the carried-over 0.80.6 behaviours. All twelve spike assertions derive `supported / environment-matched`, which is a separate check from 'the measurement happened' and failed the first time this was attested. ⚠️ CARRIED WITH AN EXPLICIT DEFERRED-VALIDATION DISPOSITION, each owned by the component it actually verifies: (1) OAuth discovery for a built-in provider — QST-0033, TSK-0066 under CMP-0027; reopens if any criterion is written as though the route were verified. (2) Pi's authentication-only TUI and what it does with no TTY — TSK-0065 under CMP-0027, narrowed to an OBSERVATION of the runtime and recording the no-TTY outcome as observed rather than as required. ⚠️ THE KILN HALF OF THAT WAS SPLIT OUT AND IS NOT A DISCOVERY UNKNOWN AT ALL: what setup must DO about a missing terminal — refuse before spawning the login process and print both recovery routes — is TSK-0068 under CMP-0039, downstream of both setup and the observation. It was split because its criterion demanded a stated Kiln recovery route, which cannot be evaluated before setup exists; a criterion that cannot be evaluated when its task completes is a promissory note. (3) The Kiln capability signature — TSK-0067 under CMP-0031, blocked on the package existing. ⚠️ AND THE CARRY-OVER CLAIM IS STATED HONESTLY: four of the five 0.80.6 behaviours were re-measured and hold; turn-end hooks in a non-interactive child were NOT re-tested, nothing in Phase 1 depends on them, and they are recorded as not-re-tested rather than as holding.
